title: Graded language
description: The two languages the system may grade (RQ-B-0-10). B3 declares it per question version; B2 selects interpreter, static checker and sandbox policy from it. Free-form language strings are forbidden.
$comment: Python maps to the CPython 3.x interpreter plus an AST checker; bash maps to bash 5.x with `bash -n` plus structured rules. Adding a language requires a P3 contract change plus a sandbox policy review (see MAIN/docs/contracts/change-protocol.md).
